Purpose: Measured per-stage cost rates of the Palace response worker / reducer / ordinary local-edge stages on one node (192 ranks, frozen executables ['8357b113c16646dd80b8262757a010b2b7671df62875289113a0d2963e3bc333', 'cc7c4091fa47bde8739fe57678d1b72a22a4aee51b0de8da18ccb9912a5aec88'], streaming one-pass Gram reducer at block size 48) refit by refit_cost_model.refit_measured from 30 measured coupons of 30 qualify runs (stage-2 2026-10-05/06 (coupons-a, coupons-bc, pair 5); PBS 56142..57626). Every time rate is the MEAN of the measurements scaled to the reference mesh spatial-35-edge-da5ddc0466ba by the exact H1 ratio and every stage carries a SafetyFactor = the largest measured wall / mean-rate estimate at the coupon's own PCG count (decision 458: a per-stage factor from the residuals, not a constant); memory peaks are the largest scaled measurement; the reducer node-used line is refit on every measured reducer with its own residual safety factor. estimate_stages.py scales the rates to another coupon mesh by the exact H1 ratio with 1x / 1.5x / 2x the mean PCG counts and applies the safety factors; the cap of every measured stage of record is above its measured wall (CapCheck).

MeasuredMesh.Label: spatial-35-edge-da5ddc0466ba identity (stage-2 2026-10-05/06 (coupons-a, coupons-bc, pair 5); 5,935,343 tets + 793,728 prisms + 61,056 pyramids, 1,538,534 nodes)

ReducerEvaluationFractionRule: the fraction of the measured ReducerPairSeconds that is the per-source-evaluation work (archive read, gradient, face-neighbour exchange, quadrature-point evaluation of every source of a block pair: N x ceil(N / b) evaluations at block size b) - it shrinks with a larger PALACE_RESPONSE_BLOCK_SIZE (decision 62(1): default 6 -> 48); the remainder is the Gram work proportional to the source pairs N (N + 1) / 2, independent of b. Measured by the decision-62 step-1 acceptance (PBS 46685, two-edge-8dd4bc70f183 p4, 78 sources, H1 7.97M, frozen b28 executable, the same archive reduced at b = 6 and b = 48): Operator Construction 86.9 s at b = 6 (1,014 evaluations, 91 block pairs) vs 15.25 s at b = 48 (156 evaluations, 3 block pairs) -> 0.0835 s per evaluation, 2.2 s of pair-scaled Gram: evaluation fraction 0.975 at b = 6, recorded as 0.97 (the Gram remainder rounded up: fail-closed side) KEPT by the stage-2 2026-10-05/06 (coupons-a, coupons-bc, pair 5) refit: one block size (48) cannot separate the evaluation and Gram parts
ReducerResidentFieldGBRule: Palace peak memory the reducer adds per resident archived source field (V, E and their grid functions with ghosts), per million H1 DOFs of the stage: 2b fields are resident per block pair, so the reducer peak at block size b is the measured peak (at MeasuredBlockSize) plus 2 (b - MeasuredBlockSize) x this x H1 / 1e6. Measured by the decision-62 step-1 acceptance (PBS 46685, two-edge p4, H1 7,973,827): Palace peak 45.6 GB at b = 6 (12 resident fields) vs 91.1 GB at b = 48 (96 fields) -> 0.542 GB per field = 0.068 GB per million H1 DOFs (node peak used 90.8 -> 136.5 GiB sampled) KEPT by the stage-2 2026-10-05/06 (coupons-a, coupons-bc, pair 5) refit as an upper bound (every reducer ran at b = 48)

PolicyRule.PCGFactors: the largest factor = max(1.5, 1.2 x the largest measured coupon-mean PCG count over the model mean, rounded up to 0.1) = 1.5 (measured ratios per order {"p3": 1.133, "p4": 1.101, "p5": 1.205}); the middle factor halfway rounded up to 0.1; previous [1.0, 1.5, 2.0] (set when the single-source maximum, not the stage mean, was the reference)
PolicyRule.PreflightAndMarginFactor: 1.1: the measured runner overhead (job total / the sum of its stage walls) is {'Count': 88, 'Min': 1.0001632084001506, 'Median': 1.0004134534509037, 'Mean': 1.001791100902681, 'Max': 1.0070019896737499} over 88 jobs; previous 1.35
PolicyRule.PreflightSeconds: 60: the measured preflight (mesh + trace digests, node checks) is 2.5 s at most on 4.7-9 M-element coupons; previous 300

ReducerPeakStreaming.Rule: ReducerPalacePeakGBEstimate of every reducer stage: SafetyFactor x PalaceGBPerGiB x (NodeBaselineGiB + (NodeUsedGiBPerMillionH1 + NodeUsedGiBPerMillionH1PerSource x sources) x H1 / 1e6), a node-used line fit by least squares on the 60 measured reducer node-used peaks of the stage-2 2026-10-05/06 (coupons-a, coupons-bc, pair 5) runs (every order, 8-source controls and the main stages); SafetyFactor = the largest measured / fitted ratio (decision 458), so the line covers every measured reducer; the per-source term is the resident archived fields (~8 bytes per H1 DOF per source)

Previous.Rule: the line of the previous model (library-device-thin-01's reducers, USER decision 2026-09-22 (B))

p3.ResidualRule: measured wall / the estimate at the model's mean rates and the block's own mean PCG count, per measured worker block and reducer; SafetyFactor = the largest (>= 1): the 1x estimate at a coupon's own PCG count covers every measured stage; the PCG spread is the PCGFactors' business

p4.ResidualRule: measured wall / the estimate at the model's mean rates and the block's own mean PCG count, per measured worker block and reducer; SafetyFactor = the largest (>= 1): the 1x estimate at a coupon's own PCG count covers every measured stage; the PCG spread is the PCGFactors' business

p5.ResidualRule: measured wall / the estimate at the model's mean rates and the block's own mean PCG count, per measured worker block and reducer; SafetyFactor = the largest (>= 1): the 1x estimate at a coupon's own PCG count covers every measured stage; the PCG spread is the PCGFactors' business

RateRule: per stage and time quantity the MEAN over the measured coupons after scaling to the reference H1 (times: x H1_ref / H1_c; the reducer block-pair seconds divided by the estimator's evaluation / Gram scale of the coupon relative to the reference source count), the PCG counts the mean of the coupon means (MaxPCGIterations the largest); memory: the largest scaled Palace peak, the largest non-Palace node remainder plus the reference peak, the largest per-source archive GB; SafetyFactor per stage (Worker / Reducer / LocalEdge) = the largest measured wall / mean-rate estimate at the coupon's own PCG count (>= 1), applied by estimate_stages to the stage's times; the worker's non-source and the reducer's setup seconds are wall-based so launch overhead is inside the estimate

Previous.Provenance: the model every qualify run up to this refit used: Measured per-stage cost rates of the Palace response worker / reducer / ordinary local-edge stages on one r8g.48xlarge node (192 ranks, frozen executable 170439c4a9fc5d5ce329310812055be5fb83a4a7f288024b57b3b83551cbe70b, streaming one-pass Gram reducer at block size 48) refit by refit_cost_model.py from the 6-coupon device library qualification library-qualification.json (tool commit 7c7bb5fe5, PBS 47080, 47081, 47082, 47083, 47084, 47086, 47105, 47106, 47107, 47108, 47109, 47110, 47207, 47212, 47213, 47214, 47215, 47216, 47218, 47219, 47250, 47256, 47289, 47290, 47291, 47298, 47300, 47301, 47335, 47336, 47348, 47349, 47356, 47358, 47467). Every rate is on the reference mesh spatial-3-edge-5d3b5e644745 and is the LARGEST the run's coupons imply once scaled to it by the exact H1 ratio (fail-closed: the 1x estimate is at least the measured wall of every stage of every coupon; SelfCheck). estimate_stages.py scales them to another hybrid prism-tube coupon mesh by the exact H1 DOF ratio with 1x / 1.5x / 2x the measured mean PCG counts.

SelfCheck.Rule: estimate_stages on every coupon of the runs under this model, read per job as the split planner does: at the measured PCG counts every job's estimate over its measured stage walls (MinimumJobEstimate1xOverStageWall) and the stage estimates over the walls (MinimumStageEstimateOverActual: below 1 only where a coupon's own PCG count exceeds the mean - the per-stage SafetyFactor is set at the coupon's own count, see ResidualRule); the jobs at the worst PCG factor with preflight and margin over the coupon's measured node seconds is the PESSIMISM (EstimateWorstWithMarginOverActual: the stated pessimism of this model and of the previous one); CapCheck: no measured stage of record above its new cap
SelfCheck.ConservativeAtOwnPCGRule: every measured worker block, reducer and local-edge stage: measured wall <= the estimate at the mean rates and its own PCG count x the stage's SafetyFactor

CapCheck.Rule: per measured coupon and stage: the measured wall, the cap of record (the run's plan) and the cap under the new model (CapSeconds = 2 x the estimate at the largest PCG factor, a block worker at its block's source count); a stage whose new cap is below its measured wall fails the refit (decision 458)
